title: Quackpond
author: Polaris Storm (as 'Quackpond Admins')
description:
Do you love ducks? Then come to Quackpond!

Quackpond is a petsite dedicated to lovable waterfowl. Create and customize your very own duck! Feed and play with your duck, and once you're done bonding with them, spend your time quacking with other members of the site through our forums, the Pond!

(Note: This game is not optimized for mobile.)

Content warning: Vulgar language and intense online social situations. This game is not meant for those under 13 years old.
